claim_boundary: This boundary records candidate-workspace readiness criteria tied to the bounded candidate-workspace fidelity matrix. It does not claim configured language/build runners, flexible solution abstraction API, candidate-embedded evaluator contracts, realistic codebase fixtures, adaptive mutation-mode selection, mutation-operator family provenance, semantic prompt-example-copy detection, cross-file consistency benchmark evidence, initial-pool divergence benchmark evidence, static/binary replay policy, topology resume replay proof, stale-readiness detector, or owner review signoff.

readiness_criteria.current_scope: manifest declarations and Python-primary code-file-set abstraction without executable non-Python/build runner parity
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: configured language/build runners plus flexible solution abstraction API evidence
readiness_criteria.search_surface: language/build runner contracts and problem-defined candidate abstraction APIs
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: language/build runner and candidate abstraction readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: external validator contract, embedded-evaluator absence boundary, and smoke fixtures
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: candidate-embedded evaluator contracts with realistic codebase fixtures
readiness_criteria.search_surface: candidate-owned evaluator contracts and realistic codebase-scale fixtures
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: embedded evaluator and codebase-scale fixture readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: Python evolve-block handling, bounded topology diagnostics, and payload-shape integrity reports
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: topology diagnostics that prove candidate workspace materialization and resume fidelity
readiness_criteria.search_surface: marker materialization, workspace topology diagnostics, and source/workspace integrity
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: workspace materialization and topology replay readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: fixed parser surfaces and run-wide mutation reports
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: adaptive mutation-mode selection with proposal-level operator-family provenance
readiness_criteria.search_surface: adaptive mutation mode selection and operator-family provenance
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: adaptive mutation and operator provenance readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: built-in copy diagnostics and best-effort Python AST symbol reports
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: semantic prompt-example-copy detection and benchmarked cross-file consistency evidence
readiness_criteria.search_surface: prompt-example copy detection and cross-file mutation consistency
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: semantic copy and cross-file consistency readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: bounded syntactic/metric initial-pool telemetry and copy-only static asset handling
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: initial-pool divergence benchmark evidence plus static/binary replay policy
readiness_criteria.search_surface: initial-pool divergence, program output discovery distance, and static/binary candidates
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: initial-pool and static/binary replay readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: snapshot restore and audit-only archive-event reconciliation without full resume proof
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: run-manifest and workspace-doc checks that prove replayable candidate-workspace resume semantics
readiness_criteria.search_surface: archive-event replay, pending-work resume, run manifests, and workspace docs
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: resume replay, run-manifest, and workspace-doc readiness gate

readiness_criteria.current_scope: bounded inventories and TODO ownership sidecars without owner signoff
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: stale-readiness detector and owner signoff before candidate-workspace fidelity claims
readiness_criteria.search_surface: README, ROADMAP, papers, run manifests, workspace docs, and owner readiness claims
